exhausted: You've used every question this closed course allows. Your conversation and the course stay here to read.
paused.workspace: Help is paused for now. Your question is saved, and course staff know.
paused.enrollment: Your help limit in this course is used up for now. Your question is saved, and course staff know.
paused.today: Help is paused until tomorrow. Your question is saved.
paused.lesson: Help for this lesson is paused until tomorrow. Your question is saved.
paused.workspaceMore: This course has a shared limit on help. Course staff can raise it.
paused.todayMore: Today's questions for this course are used up.
notSetUp: Your companion isn't on for this course yet. You can still ask; questions are saved and answered once it's on.
lessonUnavailable: This lesson isn't taking questions right now. Your draft is safe.
outsideLesson: Open a lesson to ask about it. Your conversation stays here.
offline: You're offline. Your message sends when you reconnect.
conflict: There are two versions of your draft.
recovered: Your last message was recovered. Check it in the conversation before sending another.
storage: Your draft is kept in this tab only, because browser storage is off.
closed: {remaining, plural, one {Course closed · # question left} other {Course closed · # questions left}}
closedMoreUsed: Questions never change your results. {used, number} of {budget, number} used.
